mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_application_command WHERE command_namespace=#{namespace} AND actor_type=#{actorType} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND scope=#{scope} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_application_command SET state='SUCCEEDED',result_version=1,result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_application WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM refund_application WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status IN ('PENDING_MERCHANT','APPROVED','AUTO_APPROVED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_application SET status=#{status},decision_id=#{decision},decided_by=#{operator},decided_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{application} AND status='PENDING_MERCHANT' AND version=#{version} AND decision_id IS NULL AND refund_order_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_application_decision WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_application SET refund_order_id=#{refund},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{application} AND decision_id=#{decision} AND status IN ('APPROVED','AUTO_APPROVED') AND refund_order_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.refund_no,r.order_id,r.refund_application_id AS application_id,r.source_type,r.refund_type,r.channel,r.refund_amount AS business_amount,r.refund_ratio,r.created_at AS business_created_at, e.source_type AS execution_source_type,e.source_biz_id,e.source_decision_id,e.payment_id,e.payment_no,e.store_id,e.merchant_id,e.user_id,e.payment_success_event_id,e.created_event_id,e.binding_version,e.channel_trade_no,e.currency,e.request_id,e.late_event_id,e.source_event_id,e.refund_amount,e.channel_paid_amount AS paid_amount,e.channel_paid_at AS paid_at,e.created_at FROM refund_order r JOIN refund_execution e ON e.refund_order_id=r.id AND e.refund_no=r.refund_no AND e.order_id=r.order_id WHERE r.id=#{refund} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.* FROM refund_application a WHERE a.id>#{after} AND ( (a.refund_order_id IS NULL AND ((a.status='PENDING_MERCHANT' AND a.merchant_deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR a.status IN ('APPROVED','AUTO_APPROVED'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refund_application_reconciliation_issue i WHERE i.application_id=a.id AND i.status='OPEN')) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_application_reconciliation_issue(application_id,issue_code,order_id,store_id,status,occurrence_count,created_at,last_seen_at,updated_at,resolved_at) VALUES(#{application},#{code},#{order},#{store},'OPEN',1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='OPEN',occurrence_count=occurrence_count+1,last_seen_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),resolved_at=NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_application_reconciliation_issue SET status='RESOLVED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE application_id=#{application} AND status='OPEN'
